_comment: GENERATED by tools/gen-design-examples.py. Do not edit.
Projects the editor can open cold, named in the fragment: /designer/#example=demo.
Each one is read out of the example project of the same name under examples/ by the
same code `synqt design` reads a project on disk with, so what a link hands somebody
and what the tutorial builds cannot part company. They are ordinary design documents
once loaded: edited, checked and exported exactly like something drawn by hand.
`demo` is the chat room the front page of synqt.org reads out file by file, so the
diagram there and the canvas here are the same system. The other four are what the
tutorials build, and each of those pages links here.

demo.title: The chat room
demo.note: A room, a sign-in, and two gates that are not written in the client.

gavel.title: The auction
gavel.note: Signing in, a rule the owner enforces, a permanent Hall of Fame.

arena.title: The multiplayer arena
arena.note: A world the edge simulates, and only the slice each player can see.

plaza.title: The 3D plaza
plaza.note: People walking in Qt Quick 3D, and an edge that decides where they stand.

stall.title: The light storefront
stall.note: Pages the edge delivers, so a campaign changes with no rebuild.

-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Alexandre 'kidev' Poumaroux
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

-- The durable stock. Applied by the persistence blueprint at startup; forward-only
-- migrations extend it. The sku is the internal key the edge fills its catalog from; it
-- never crosses to the browser-facing offers model.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
    sku   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    price INTEGER NOT NULL
);
